companies.name: Amcor plc
companies.company_summary: Amcor is a global packaging company that develops and produces flexible packaging solutions for food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and other industries. Its product range includes films, pouches, and laminates, with a focus on sustainability and innovation. As a distributor in this market, Amcor supplies these flexible packaging products to end-users and retailers, managing logistics and inventory.

companies.name: Berry Global
companies.company_summary: Berry Global is a manufacturer of flexible packaging products, including films, pouches, and containers, serving the food and beverage industries. The company emphasizes innovative and sustainable packaging solutions. In this distribution section, Berry Global distributes its flexible packaging products to customers, ensuring availability and timely delivery.

companies.name: ExxonMobil Chemical
companies.company_summary: ExxonMobil Chemical produces a range of polyethylene and polypropylene resins used in the manufacture of flexible packaging films, serving converters and brand owners globally.

companies.name: Huhtamaki Oyj
companies.company_summary: Huhtamaki is a global manufacturer of flexible packaging and fiber-based foodservice packaging, serving food and beverage industries with sustainable solutions.

companies.name: LyondellBasell Industries Holdings B.V.
companies.company_summary: LyondellBasell is a global producer of polyolefin resins, supplying materials used in flexible packaging films and other applications.

companies.name: ProAmpac
companies.company_summary: ProAmpac is a global leader in flexible packaging, producing a wide range of films, pouches, and bags for food, beverage, and consumer products. They focus on innovative, sustainable packaging solutions.

companies.name: SABIC
companies.company_summary: SABIC is a global chemical company that produces a wide range of petrochemical products, including polyethylene and polypropylene resins used in the production of flexible packaging films. They supply these materials to film manufacturers and converters worldwide.

companies.name: TC Transcontinental
companies.company_summary: TC Transcontinental is a Canadian-based manufacturer of flexible packaging solutions, producing films, pouches, and printed packaging for food and consumer goods markets. They also have a presence in printing and media services.

companies.name: Toray Industries, Inc.
companies.company_summary: Toray Industries is a global chemical and materials company that produces a wide range of films, including BOPET and BOPP films used in flexible packaging. Their films provide barrier properties, strength, and printability for food and industrial packaging.

companies.name: Uflex
companies.company_summary: Uflex is a global flexible packaging company that manufactures a wide range of films and packaging solutions, serving food, beverage, and pharmaceutical sectors.

companies.name: Winpak Ltd.
companies.company_summary: Winpak manufactures high-quality flexible packaging materials, primarily for the food and beverage industry, offering products like films, pouches, and lidding. The company focuses on barrier performance and sustainability. As a distributor, Winpak supplies these flexible packaging products to end-users, providing reliable distribution and support.

companies.name: Cosmofilms
companies.company_summary: Cosmofilms is a manufacturer of flexible packaging materials, producing films and pouches for various industries including food and pharmaceuticals. The company focuses on creating packaging solutions that meet the needs of these sectors.

companies.name: Jindal Poly Films Limited
companies.company_summary: Jindal Poly Films is a leading manufacturer of biaxially oriented polyester (BOPET) and polypropylene (BOPP) films, serving the flexible packaging industry with high-performance films for food, pharmaceutical, and industrial applications. The company is a major supplier of these films globally.

companies.name: Jpflfilms
companies.company_summary: Jpflfilms manufactures flexible packaging films and pouches, serving food and industrial sectors with printed and laminated packaging solutions. The company provides customized packaging options to its clients.

companies.name: Satyendra Group
companies.company_summary: Satyendra Group is an Indian manufacturer of flexible packaging films, including BOPP and BOPET films, serving the packaging industry with products for food and industrial applications. The company is involved in the production of these films for various uses.

companies.name: Poly Source
companies.company_summary: Poly Source is a distributor of flexible packaging films and related materials, supplying converters and manufacturers in the packaging industry. The company focuses on distribution and supply chain services.

companies.name: Sealed Air
companies.company_summary: Sealed Air is a global packaging company that produces flexible packaging solutions for food preservation and protective packaging, serving industries such as food processing, e-commerce, and logistics. The company is known for brands like Cryovac and Bubble Wrap.

companies.name: Mondi
companies.company_summary: Mondi is a global packaging and paper company that produces flexible packaging, paper bags, and containerboard, serving various industries including food and beverage, personal care, and industrial sectors. The company operates across the packaging value chain.

companies.name: SRF Limited
companies.company_summary: SRF Limited is an Indian multinational that manufactures a range of products including flexible packaging films. The company operates in various industrial sectors. It is a major player in the packaging materials market.
